#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    vector<int> nums;
    int x;
    while (cin >> x) {
        nums.push_back(x);
    }
    // nums[0] is n, but not used
    int a[3] = {nums[1], nums[2], nums[3]};
    int b[3] = {nums[4], nums[5], nums[6]};

    int min_val = max(0, a[0] - b[0] - b[2]) +
                  max(0, a[1] - b[0] - b[1]) +
                  max(0, a[2] - b[1] - b[2]);

    int max_val = min(a[0], b[1]) +
                  min(a[1], b[2]) +
                  min(a[2], b[0]);

    cout << min_val << " " << max_val << endl;
    return 0;
}
